name: Qualia
source:
One one of summer vacation days main character receives an e-mail from his student inviting him to visit a certain small town. He arrives to a wealthy house. Strange murders start to happen with corpses being found on the streets. The town burns up with paranoia, and protagonist becomes one of the main suspects. He will have to take some important decisions which is a matter of life and death.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假中的一天，主角收到學生寄來的一封電子郵件，邀請他前往某座小鎮。他應邀而來，住進了一戶富裕人家的宅邸。隨後，離奇的兇殺案接連發生，街頭不斷發現屍體。疑懼的情緒籠罩了整個小鎮，主角也成了主要嫌疑人之一。他必須做出幾個重要的抉擇，而這些選擇關乎生死。

（摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]）
